name: hubspot-calle
title: HubSpot CALL-E private serverless direct-call scaffold
description: Serverless-only private HubSpot Projects 2026.03 scaffold that creates CALL-E call tasks directly from HubSpot workflows without HubSpot CRM write permissions.
side_effects: The direct-call workflow action creates a CALL-E call task after validating workflow inputs.
The Contact App Cards create a CALL-E call task only after an explicit confirmation.
The integration does not create HubSpot CRM properties, tasks, notes, or custom objects in low-permission mode.
CALL-E status and results remain in CALL-E unless a higher-permission HubSpot mode is implemented.
credentials: CALL-E API key stored in HubSpot serverless secrets.
HubSpot App Client Secret and workflow action URL stored in HubSpot serverless secrets for request-signature validation.
No credentials or live customer records should be committed to this repository.
safety: Use workflow triggers that represent explicit call intent before direct CALL-E call creation.
Masks phone numbers in summaries, examples, logs, and workflow output.
Uses stable idempotency keys to avoid duplicate calls.
Validates HubSpot custom-action v3 request signatures and timestamps before a workflow can call CALL-E.
Does not create hidden recurring schedules.
The workflow endpoint creates a call only when consent is explicitly true and do-not-call is explicitly false; enrollment filters must also exclude non-consenting and do-not-call records.

Canceling an App Card confirmation prevents only that pending submission. Once CALL-E accepts a call, use CALL-E-supported dashboard or API controls; disabling workflows or rotating secrets prevents new calls only.
Prepends every CALL-E task with a fixed, non-overridable instruction that prohibits medical, legal, financial, and emergency advice and limits those topics to logistics or routing.
